about: Someone turns against the company, and why (cause: attack, spell, theft, trespass, toll, insult): said so that the player sees what they did and what it means.

lines.text: {Actor} [see|sees] the spell begin, and [take|takes] it for what it is: an attack. Weapons come out.
{Actor} [turn|turns] on you. There is no taking it back now.
{Actor} [see|sees] what you have taken. From now on {they} [are|is] no friend of yours.
Word reaches {actor} of what you have taken. From now on {they} [are|is] no friend of yours.
{Actor} will not forget that you ran the toll.
